resources.string: Relays the currently playing external media session

This app needs notification-listener access to detect which app is currently playing media — that\'s how it finds the active session to mirror. It never reads notification text/content, only media-session info (title, artist, playback state).
Also allow unrestricted background running, so OriginOS doesn\'t kill the bridge while your screen is off or another app is in the foreground.
